surfaces.atlas_console: Custom remote MCP connector URL, OAuth and browser consent are first-class zero-install setup. CLI/plugins are optional. Console owns signup, invitation acceptance, line exposure, vault grants and exact-installation invitation permission; MCP App never substitutes agent credentials for human authority. The Developers section owns scoped app-key issuance/revocation and a draft Lines API reference; the inline App links to the Console and never issues keys. Conversations supports account-only human contact/task interaction alongside advanced Line activity; optional GPT-Live voice is explicitly configured and live-unverified.
surfaces.atlas_registration_inspect: Skill/CLI inspection; MCP App header uses atlas_console.
surfaces.atlas_lines_register: MCP App registration; owner authorises installation in Console.
surfaces.atlas_endpoints_attach: Tool/CLI: attach/resume a stable installation-scoped clientKey; optional mutable claimed label. No cross-installation rebinding. Inline continues using its installation default.
surfaces.atlas_contacts_list: MCP App lists ownLines separately from relationship peers; memo composer supports owned lines without inventing self-relationships. Owner Console manages line lifecycle and cross-account invitation/exposure. Discovery grants no vault rights.
surfaces.atlas_messages_send: MCP App direct owned-line/contact memo and cross-account subscriber composer. Self-send and own-subscriber broadcasts are rejected. Other classes/causation through skill/CLI and explicit Pi tools; pull only. Phase 1: canonical claimed parts/subject/summary/intent are read by Console, inline App, controller and Pi. Structured sending uses tools/CLI; existing inline text composer remains shorthand. No new composer, threads, human state or shared display block.
surfaces.atlas_messages_list: Legacy manual history/pagination through tools/CLI; no implicit acknowledgment. MCP App uses atlas_inbox_check pending/history. The 0.7.0 owner inbox inspector and installation HTTP history query are separate read-only surfaces; new query discovery through MCP/CLI/Inline is explicitly deferred. Existing tools remain available and unchanged.
surfaces.atlas_messages_acknowledge: MCP App explicit per-message dismissal and tools: requires prior fetch by this consumer; omitted endpoint uses installation default. Never task approval.
surfaces.atlas_resources_read: MCP App memory URI resolver; workflow guides (atlas://guides), charter and other resource kinds through tools/skill/CLI. Remote connectors without an installed skill read atlas://guides/atlas.
surfaces.atlas_context_publish: MCP App private expiring snapshot composer; sharing in owner Console.
surfaces.atlas_endpoints_state: Skill/CLI only: runtime reports its own state; a panel cannot infer worker activity.
surfaces.atlas_services: MCP App Services inspection and runtime proposal; connector consent/deploy/stop/delete in owner Console. Explicit reads/runs and child_prepare through skill/CLI. New resource simulation proposals are a separate scoped Lines API draft; MCP/CLI/Pi and owner resource UI parity is explicitly deferred. Existing provider/runtime behavior is unchanged.
surfaces.atlas_context_vaults: MCP App Memory vaults discovery and effective-access state.
surfaces.atlas_context_search: MCP App bounded search; advanced metadata filters through skill/CLI.
surfaces.atlas_context_read: MCP App selected memory inspection; pinned revision reads through resource URI or skill/CLI.
surfaces.atlas_context_write: Skill/CLI: persist full request and operation token outside transient panel state before write.
surfaces.atlas_context_import: Skill/CLI: persist full source-aware request and retry identity; no automatic ingestion.
surfaces.atlas_context_export: Skill/CLI: bounded selected-ID export, no whole-vault sync.
surfaces.atlas_context_policy_inspect: MCP App policy pages for explicitly authorised controller installations; owner Console also inspects.
surfaces.atlas_context_policy_propose: MCP App exact scoped proposal for authorised controller installations; human approval remains in Console.
surfaces.atlas_context_policy_status: MCP App proposal lookup; decisions only in owner Console.
surfaces.atlas_inbox_next: Legacy streaming endpoint/filter fetch checkpoint for harness/CLI and explicit Pi tools, unchanged. Ordinary inbox checks use atlas_inbox_check.
surfaces.atlas_messages_status: Tool/CLI and explicitly configured Pi delivery inspection; MCP App displays send result and envelope, no automatic status polling.
surfaces.atlas_contacts_invite: Permissioned MCP/CLI/explicit Pi tool: exact installation can_invite defaults false and only human owners enable it in Console. Tool queues email; human Console handles verified recipient acceptance/decline and explicit exposure. Inline MCP App deliberately links to Console rather than adding unsolicited mail controls. Controller tools cannot grant invitation authority.
surfaces.atlas_inbox_check: MCP App and tools: durable exact-installation default consumer, pending/history pages and exact-request recovery. Explicit endpoints remain independent. Fetch does not acknowledge; no push or model-attention claim. clientKey can resume an attached consumer without UUID bookkeeping. Manual counts include handoffs; automatic inbox hints exclude same-line notes.
surfaces.atlas_endpoints_list: MCP/HTTP/CLI read-only current-installation or same-line destination discovery; foreign endpoints grant no read/ack authority.
surfaces.atlas_handoffs_leave: MCP/HTTP/CLI shared or exact named same-line destination memos. Independent consumer fetch/ack; installation-local named destination hints suppress source-self hints. Owner line history remains inspectable. Inline default reading only; named checks/composition use MCP/CLI. Dedicated composer and Pi handoff tools deferred. No host wake, inference or vault mutation. Uses the same canonical claimed message content and bounds as send.
surfaces.atlas_tasks: MCP/API/Lines and A2A façade share durable task authority. Explicit recipient reports; no receipt-derived completion. Owner consent API initially; Console/RN/inline task UI deliberately deferred. Existing message surfaces retain their behavior; Pi/CLI can call tools under their current grants. Managed 0.11 uses the same task domain through permission-checked functions. Console preset/create/manual checks/activity/approval and subscriber SDK share owner control-plane resources; general external ingestion/schedules, mobile and inline management deliberately deferred. Pi/Sprite preserved as legacy, not the new managed path. Automatic source-task policies require execution authority and retain approving-key expiry/revocation. Human approvals require current owner membership. Unreleased 0.12 adds a separate session-authenticated human Conversations gateway over the same task domain; private initiating-user membership, explicit client address and bounded, call-authorized captured speech. The application seals speech using transcript/delegation timing and microphone settling; no provider transcript-done event or live audio validation is claimed. No new MCP tool, developer-key impersonation, mobile implementation or automatic remote execution grant.
surfaces.atlas_agent_participation: MCP read-only installation-specific enrollment/profile discovery; human enrollment/revocation uses owner API. Managed identity bundles use same Line and scopes; no live provisioning or implicit vault/contact grant.
surfaces.atlas_host_notifications: Read-only MCP delivery state; Dots native events protocol uses same authenticated installation; Grok routine URL/bearer is owner-only. No provider credentials returned. Owner API consent first, UI deliberately deferred.
surfaces.atlas_sms_turns: MCP and scoped Lines API share exact installation-bound text-turn inspection and one fixed-recipient bounded reply. Human owner provisions own verified phone, current purpose consent, number/source/recipient route and expiry through the owner API. No third-party or arbitrary-recipient sends, campaigns, MMS, voice bridge, implicit vault access or native host/thread acceptance. CLI/inline/mobile UI deferred; public catalog and guide require reviewed pin before release.
surfaces.atlas_call_turns: Account UI atomically records one verified-own-phone callback/transcription purpose consent and canonical task wake. Reads/reloads never request a call. MCP/scoped Lines API fulfill only that exact prepared callback with separate calls:request authority, inspect private input and queue one plain-text reply. Stop requests revoke authority and request teardown; they do not prove audio ceased. One final phrase and reply only; continuous dialog, barge-in, native host audio and host-private thread/memory acceptance remain unverified or unsupported.
surfaces.atlas_sms_send: Shared MCP and scoped Lines API capability for dots and optional Workers: discover explicit owner-consented verified-phone routes, initiate one short fixed-recipient SMS with saved intent, and inspect its status. Requires sms:send plus tasks:read, current installation/purpose/number grants, finite cost authority and rate bounds. STOP blocks future sends; no arbitrary destination, silent channel fallback or retry of unknown effects. Controlled tests do not establish native host or handset acceptance.
surfaces.atlas_signal_status: Read-only Signal view over existing Vault authority and storage; old context tools remain compatibility aliases. Signal observations do not establish source synchronization, factual confidence or complete coverage. Shared voice runtime requires an additional trusted caller-bound policy; no arbitrary caller selector, private history ingestion, data grant, paid inference or live-call activation.

surfaces.atlas_signal_write: Signal archival input editing/organization through the exact existing Vault write protocol and owner-approved full write grant. Stable ID, target-bound operationId, CAS, revocation and replay rules preserved; no raw filesystem edits, automatic ingestion or derived inference rewrite. Not selected for managed/voice tools by default.
surfaces.atlas_signal_import: Signal archival source reconciliation through the existing full-write Vault import protocol. Source metadata remains untrusted; permission, source identity, explicit edit and tombstone protection are unchanged. No connector credential/grant inheritance.
surfaces.atlas_signal_refresh: Bounded current authorized archive-only topic search, with explicit partial result, excerpts and unknown connector/topic coverage. Available to existing MCP installations and opt-in managed Workers; current grant checked on each call/retained result. Shared live-voice callers require additional trusted call-bound policy and refresh consent. External connector execution remains a separate configured adapter.
